scope: Previous coordinator mid-task snapshot through end-of-turn plus independent reviewer. Excludes earlier research discovery and current delivery/resume turn; not task-exclusive total.
normalization: Raw source-native counters retained. Reasoning is not added to output. Cached input overlap must follow producer accounting semantics.

probe_window.coverage_note: Probe timings exclude startup/import/pin checks and coordinator/reviewer/tool-server costs. RSS is per-process lifetime peak, not aggregate memory.
